Subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo / technical deep dive

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we're aligned:

- Primary goals: reduce inference latency for user-facing features and lower per-token cost
- Current constraints: multi-region deployment, SSO/KMS requirements, 99.9% availability target
- Timeline: looking to start a pilot in Q4, production in Q1

Next step: schedule a 45-60 minute demo + technical deep dive with our Solutions Engineer to walk through run-of-show, performance profiles, and a short Q&A on integration patterns. Proposed times (all PDT):

- Wed, Aug 4 — 10:00–11:00 AM
- Thu, Aug 5 — 2:00–3:00 PM
- Fri, Aug 6 — 9:00–10:00 AM

Can you confirm which of these works best? If none fit, please propose 2 windows next week and we'll tighten confirmation on our side (I'll send calendar invites as tentatives and follow up 24 hours before). I've cc'd Rafael (SE) — he'll join the demo for deeper technical Qs.

Attaching the discovery deck we referenced: Redwood-Discovery-Deck.pdf

Thanks, and talk soon —

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Hi Marissa —

Really appreciate the recap. Apologies — I had an exec conflict immediately after our call and missed the follow-up (my bad). The proposed slots this week look tight for our team. Can we move to next week? Here are two windows that work for us (PDT):

- Tue, Aug 10 — 11:00 AM–12:00 PM
- Wed, Aug 11 — 3:00–4:00 PM

Please cc our SRE lead (sam.patel@acmecorp.com) on the invite — we want to make sure Rafael can dig into perf/ops items. Also: we missed a couple of the earlier points on SSO and data retention — can Rafael make sure those are on the demo agenda?

One ask on our end: we had a no-show on a vendor meeting last month, so if possible could you send a calendar invite with RSVP and we'll accept to lock the slot? Tight confirmation helps avoid last-minute conflicts.

Thanks — looking forward to the deep dive.

Best,
